title: Hanoi + Sapa
subtitle: 24–29 Dec 2026 · 6 days · 5 nights · 2 travellers

flights.carriers: Out 24 Dec 08:00 · return 29 Dec 16:00 · Scoot / VietJet / Vietnam Airlines
flights.fare: S$620 return for 2 pax (S$310 each) — book 6–8 weeks ahead

expenses: Planned S$2,285 for two, cap S$2,500 — flights included

intro_beats.text: Hanoi and Sapa, six days over Christmas, two travellers. Two nights in the Old Quarter, two in the mountains.
Changi to Noi Bai at eight on the twenty-fourth, back at four on the twenty-ninth — about six hundred and twenty dollars return for two.
Two thousand two hundred and eighty-five dollars planned for two, flights included, inside a twenty-five hundred cap.
The Old Quarter: pho, egg coffee, water puppets, bia hoi on Ta Hien.
Fansipan at three thousand one hundred and forty-three metres, if the cloud lifts.
And the Muong Hoa valley, trekking Lao Chai to Ta Van.

outro.heading: The budget
outro.text: Two thousand two hundred and eighty-five dollars for two, inside a twenty-five hundred cap. Book flights and the Fansipan ticket first, then check the Sapa forecast the week you go — late December is fog season.

days.title: Arrival, lake walk and water puppets
days.caveat: Flights NOT YET BOOKED — 6–8 weeks ahead

beats.text: The eight o'clock flight lands at half ten; Grab to the Old Quarter, beef pho by one.
beats.caption: Noi Bai → Old Quarter

beats.text: Hoan Kiem and Ngoc Son temple, then egg coffee at Cafe Giang.
beats.caption: Hoàn Kiếm · Ngọc Sơn

beats.text: Water puppets at seven, then bia hoi and skewers on Ta Hien.
beats.caption: Thang Long water puppets

days.title: Temples, museums and a food crawl

beats.text: Christmas is a working day here. Temple of Literature at half eight, then the Imperial Citadel.
beats.caption: Temple of Literature

beats.text: Banh cuon first, bun cha at Huong Lien, Museum of Ethnology in the afternoon.
beats.caption: Museum of Ethnology

beats.text: Tran Quoc Pagoda at sunset, then a food walk and rooftop drinks over the lake.
beats.caption: West Lake

beats.text: The six-thirty limousine north, five and a half hours, and the temperature drops the whole way.
Check in at the Pistachio on Cau May, salmon pho, then the lake and town viewpoint.
beats.caption: Sa Pa

beats.text: Night market for skewers, rooftop pool, early night.

days.title: Fansipan, then the Mường Hoa valley
days.caveat: Fog is common — the cable car can be a white-out

beats.text: Cable car at eight, up to three thousand one hundred and forty-three metres before the queues.
beats.caption: Fansipan cable car

beats.text: Then the trek from Lao Chai to Ta Van, through the Muong Hoa valley.
Salmon hotpot, and the craft brewery for a nightcap.

days.title: Hidden trail, then back to Hanoi
bullets: Bánh mì · Hồ Gươm at night

beats.text: Early on the hidden trail to Y Linh Ho, below the tourist path.
Check out at eleven; the twelve-thirty limousine back to Hanoi by half six.
Banh Mi 25 for dinner, then Hoan Kiem at night and one last egg coffee.
beats.caption: Hồ Gươm at night

days.title: Mausoleum morning, market run, flight home

beats.text: The Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum complex early, before the queues.
beats.caption: Hồ Chí Minh Mausoleum

beats.text: Dong Xuan market, a last banh mi, and a Grab to Noi Bai at half one.
beats.caption: Đồng Xuân Market

beats.text: Three hours before the four o'clock flight; Changi by nine.
beats.caption: Noi Bai (HAN)
